Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc

Class MetadataReader

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc.MetadataReader
public final class MetadataReader extends Object
Reads database structure (catalogs, schemas, tables, columns, keys) through the standard JDBC DatabaseMetaData API, so the navigator works against any driver without database-specific SQL.

Every method is blocking and returns immutable snapshots; the navigator calls them lazily as the user expands a node, so a large schema is never fully walked up front. All methods throw SQLException for the caller to surface.
